recommendation_issues.problem: The clause 'güzde dersin bittiği gün ya da en çok 2 gün sonrası' rests on the graduate calendar; for undergraduates it is the last class day. Also say what the instructor enters in AKSİS on the deadline day for rows still marked KARAR BEKLİYOR; otherwise the new 'phone not synced since last session' trigger produces a 'geçici' output with no instruction at the moment it must be used.

(a) A final state named 'Kurul raporu' and storing the report's 'türü ve tarihleri' records which kind of health report a student had, which contradicts the plan's own rule at line 383 ('Sağlık bilgisi tutulmaz'). Neutral codes do the same job: 'Görevli' for all hours, and one neutral code such as 'Belgeli, yalnız teori' for the Madde 7(3) exclusion, with the student affairs letter number as the document number, not the report number or e-Rapor code. (b) 'T değişmez' for 7(3) hours is an interpretation; label it an assumption and add it to the student affairs question. (c) The plan has no separate 'izin' category today (line 383: 'Ayrı kategori yok'); only the scope of 'belgeli düzeltme' changes. (d) A single final state per session cannot drop only the theory hours of a mixed theory and practice lesson; this needs the hour-level correction from S14-04.

Acceptable only inside the existing correction flow, shown only for lessons longer than one hour, default 'tüm saatler'. It turns the per-session final state (line 221) into an hour count per session (line 792); the data model section must say so.

'Hoca muaf işaretlerken tekrar nedenini seçer' adds a step whose answer the rules never use (Muaf means no requirement whatever the reason). One help line under the Muaf switch is enough: 'FF, DC ya da DD ile tekrar: muaf. FD ile tekrar ve iki kez kalınan klinik ders: muaf değil.'

Two optional fields for faculties outside the first department add model surface with no current user. Cheaper and honest: write the limit in the plan (Md.19/2 anabilim dalı hesabı ve yıllık dersler ilk sürümde yok) and correct line 735's 'yapı değişmeden genişler'. (cihaz, sıra numarası) gaps only show missing records that sit between received ones. verdict_reason: No high-severity finding is refuted or unverifiable. S14-02 is confirmed verbatim against the İÜ Öğrenci Sağlık Raporları Yönergesi (Madde 6, 7/2, 7/3, 10). S14-01 holds with a correction that makes it stronger: for ön lisans/lisans the absence-entry deadline is the last class day, and the '2 days later' figure came from the graduate calendar; S14-18 carries the same correction. The other 16 findings are confirmed, with severity overstated for S14-05 and S14-06.
